records.description: Jacobi Park is a neighbourhood green space in Hamburg, just off Wandsbeker Chaussee near Hasselbrookstraße. Its paths have been mentioned by gay cruising guides for years, but in this case there is also genuinely recent visitor evidence. A contributor writing on 17 January 2026 reported that the previous evening was active, while March posts include a same-day encounter and another visitor describing a meeting on Friday 6 March. The accounts make the evenings a sensible time to try, although they don't establish a guaranteed crowd or a reliable age range. This isn't a men-only park: nearby residents, dog walkers and other visitors share the paths. Some older posts allege harassment and loss of cover, but there isn't evidence that those exact conditions persisted in 2026. Stay on open paths, respect other people's privacy, and judge the atmosphere rather than assuming everybody is cruising.
records.address: Jacobi Park, Wandsbeker Chaussee / Hasselbrookstraße, Hamburg
records.tags: Park, Evening, Recent Firsthand Reports, Neighbourhood
records.opening_notes: January–March 2026 visitors reported evening encounters; these are not guaranteed times.
caveats: Older harassment accounts should be treated as historical, not a current patrol warning
Mixed park used by dog walkers and local residents

records.description: Blindengarten is a smaller planted and wooded section of Hamburg's Stadtpark, around Südring and Otto-Wels-Straße rather than the whole enormous park. Three gay cruising guides have identified the area, and 2026 visitor posts offer unusually detailed recent evidence. January and March visitors described encounters and repeat use, while others in April and May found fewer contacts and complained that vegetation had been cleared or old shelters removed. One late-night visit in May produced no meeting at all, so this isn't a guaranteed busy night spot. It's an ordinary park with other visitors and nearby residential areas. Be aware that older comments report intimidation and harassment, although those incidents have not been independently confirmed as ongoing. The safest description is a recognised historic meeting area with continuing but variable activity and changing privacy.
records.address: Stadtpark Blindengarten, near Südring / Otto-Wels-Straße, Hamburg
records.tags: Park, Wooded Paths, Recent Reports, Mixed Activity, Safety Warning
records.opening_notes: 2026 successful visits include January and March; a May late-night visitor found nobody. Peak times uncertain.
caveats: Vegetation clearance and removal of old shelter may affect privacy

records.description: Altonaer Volkspark is much larger than its cruising-directory shorthand 'Volkspark II' suggests. Historic guides mention several separate parts of the park, including parking near the Bauernhaus or Nansenstraße and routes towards Sylvesterallee. Those are not necessarily one meeting point, and nearby stadium events can bring crowds of people who have nothing to do with cruising. First-person visitors in July 2026 described empty or very quiet evenings despite old listings promising busy nights. A positive encounter from 2024 is too old to establish current activity. Park paths are generally accessible for ordinary recreation, but road closures and parking arrangements change during events. Without identifying which of the old subareas still operates, and with the latest reports largely negative, it shouldn't be recommended as an active cruising venue.
blockers: Several historic subareas, not one precise location
Older crowd predictions out of date
records.address: Altonaer Volkspark, near Nansenstraße / Sylvesterallee, Hamburg
records.tags: Large Park, Woodland, Car Park, Historical Reports
records.opening_notes: No confirmed current peak hours; stadium events may affect access.

records.description: The public toilet by Hannover's Maschsee, around Altenbekener Damm and Rudolf-von-Bennigsen-Ufer, appears in older gay cruising guides as a meeting place. Its physical layout, however, has changed. A returning visitor in June 2026 reported that openings between cubicles had been removed during refurbishment, while another May visitor found nobody there. Recent questions about the old layout should not be mistaken for proof of continued sexual activity. This is a shared public facility beside one of Hannover's most popular recreation areas, with walkers, cyclists and families nearby. There's no trustworthy recent encounter report, no established age mix and no reliable time to go based on the current layout. The historical listing may explain the location's reputation, but it isn't enough to recommend the restroom in its present condition.
blockers: Most recent visits negative or questioning
records.tags: Lake, Public Restroom, Renovated, Historical Reports
records.opening_notes: Public toilet operating times depend on operator; old guide details may no longer apply.

records.description: The public restroom near the Garkenburgstraße entrance to Hannover's Stadtfriedhof Seelhorst has an old gay cruising-directory entry. Historical posts describe encounters, but more recent firsthand reports are consistently discouraging. A regular visitor in June 2026 said several visits had yielded nobody, and a December 2025 visitor likewise found no one despite messages written on the walls. One other commenter said he sometimes attended in the morning, but that was not an encounter report. Cemetery opening hours, posted conduct rules and other visitors' privacy are relevant here: this is not a dedicated meeting venue. With no clear recent activity and no trustworthy busy period or visitor profile, it should remain a retained research lead rather than being promoted as an operating cruising spot.
blockers: Latest firsthand reports say no activity
records.address: Stadtfriedhof Seelhorst, Garkenburgstraße entrance area, Hannover
